1. test/specs/REQ-203.md, item 2 (AC1 forced-failure rollback): replaced the 'real finding... surfaces this failure as a RAISED Ecto.ConstraintError... flagged for REVIEWER' language (framed as an open, current defect) with past-tense text stating the gap was found blocking at Step 3b, fixed in commit 6169d009 via foreign_key_constraint/3 on Activation.changeset/2, and that the test now asserts {:error, {:validation, changeset}} with changeset.errors[:active_version_id] == {"does not exist", _}.

3. test/specs/REQ-203.md, 'Real Postgres runs performed during test design' section: rewrote the FK-failure bullet to state the actual resolution (the raised-exception behavior was flagged blocking at Step 3b and fixed by ELIXIR-DEV in commit 6169d009, not resolved by 'asserting the real observed exception rather than an invented one').
4. test/letflow/repository/activation_test.exs's @moduledoc (lines ~25-33): same three corrections -- '@typep test_opts' instead of '@type test_opts moduledoc', and REVIEWER's sign-off stated as resolved (two rework rounds, compile-time gating + typing fix), not an open flag.

No test assertion, test helper, fixture, or any line of lib/letflow/repository/activation.ex was touched -- verified via `git diff --stat` before committing (only test/specs/REQ-203.md and test/letflow/repository/activation_test.exs changed, and within the latter only the @moduledoc block).
